blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Philippine government has granted Hungary bilateral recognition of its bird flu status, ensuring safe and continuous poultry trade between the two nations. The Department of Agriculture (DA) has formalized the removal of countrywide import restrictions on domestic and wild birds and their products, as stated in Department Circular No. 52. READ: Agri department pushes vaccines for bird flu, swine fever Hungary will permit poultry exports only from regions free of bird flu (HPAI) All poultry shipments from Hungary must adhere to regionalization import terms, Administrative Circular No. 09 for HPAI, and current DA regulations.
